sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Cold Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean, Deep Lukewarm Ocean, Deep Ocean, Lukewarm Ocean, Ocean, River, and Warm Ocean.

sections.heading: Description
lines: Water Surface is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as an Elemental field and can be found in any area while using Surf, with notable battles including the battle against Valarie on Terajuma.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: Icy Field will transform into this field if Water Surface is the Sub-layer and the moves Bulldoze, Burning Jaleousy, Dive, Earthquake, Eruption, Fire Pledge, Fissure, Flame Burst, Heat Wave, Incinerate, Lava Plume, Magma Drift, Magnitude, Mind Blown, Raging Fury, Searing Shot, or the Z-Moves Inferno Overdrive or Tectonic Rage are used.
“The quake broke up the ice and revealed the water beneath!”
“The ice melted away!”
“[Pokémon] made a hole in the ice!”
“The ice was broken from underneath!”
Icy Field will also transform into this field if the Cave Field isn't the Sub-layer and the moves Hydro Steam, Matcha Gotcha or Scald are used 2 times, or if the move Steam Eruption is used 1 time.
“Parts of the ice melted!”
“The hot water melted the ice!”
“The hot tea melted the ice!”
If the Sub-layer is Cave Field, Icy Field will transform into it instead.
Specifically, using Hydro Steam, Scald or Matcha Gotcha increments the counter by +1, and using Steam Eruption increments it by +2. The field changes when the counter reaches 2.
Underwater will transform into this field if the moves Bounce, Dive, Fly, Shore Up, Sky Drop, or Triple Dive are used.
“The battle resurfaced!”
Murkwater Surface will transform into this field if the move Tidy Up is used 2 times, or the moves Purify or Whirlpool are used 1 time.
“The attack cleared the waters!”
“The maelstrom flushed out the poison!”
“Some sludge was tidied up!”

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Water-type moves → 1.5x boost.
“The water strengthened the attack!”
Electric-type moves → 1.5x boost against grounded Pokémon.
“The water conducted the attack!”
Fire-type moves → 0.5x decrease against grounded Pokémon.
“The water deluged the attack...”
Ground-type moves always fail.
“...But there was no solid ground to attack from!”
Dig fails on the turn where the Pokémon would go underground.
Shore Up is the only exception due to it changing to a Water-type move on this field.
Grounded non-Water-type Pokémon have their Speed decreased to 0.75x.
Pokémon with the abilities Surge Surfer or Swift Swim are immune to this effect.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Activated Abilities (when grounded):
Hydration
Schooling
Applies even when the user is level 19 or less.
Surge Surger
Swift Swim
Torrent
Buffed Abilities:
Dry Skin & Water Absorb restore 1/16 of the bearer's Max HP at the end of each turn if it's grounded.
“[Pokémon] absorbed some of the water!”
Foam Spray reduces Defense by 2 stages on activation.
Propeller Tail boosts the damage of the bearer's priority moves by 1.5x.
This does not apply to moves that gain priority (Example: Grassy Glide, Gale Wings).
Steam Engine raises the bearer's Speed by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
Water Compaction activates at the end of each turn if the user is grounded.
Water Veil cures all status conditions.
Other Ability Changes:
Gulp Missile will always pick up Arrokuda.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Dive → 1.2x boost, only lasts 1 turn.
“The attack rode the current!”
Whirlpool → 1.2x boost, 1/6 Max HP as damage at the end of each turn.
“The attack rode the current!”
Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Octazooka, Origin Pulse, Surf, Sludge Wave, Triple Dive → 1.2x boost.
“The attack rode the current!”
“Poison spread through the water!”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Aqua Ring restores 1/8 max HP each turn.
Life Dew additionally applies Aqua Ring to the user.
Shore Up becomes a Water-type move and activates Water Compaction.
Splash lowers the Accuracy of all adjacent Pokémon by 1 stage.
Take Heart raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 2 stages.
Wave Crash's recoil is halved to 25%.
Nerfed Moves:
Spikes and Toxic Spikes disappear and cannot be placed.
“...The spikes sank into the water and vanished!”
Spikes and Toxic Spikes only disappear when a Pokémon would switch in on that side.
Example: If Spikes are set on Icy Field, then the field is changed to Water Surface, then back to Icy Field before any switches happen on that side of the field, Spikes will remain.
Tar Shot gets removed at the end of the turn.
“The tar washed off [Pokémon] in the water!”
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Water.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Water.
Nature Power becomes Whirlpool.
Secret Power may lower Speed.
Shelter halves damage from Water-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Water.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
This field will transform into Underwater if the moves Anchor Shot, Dive, Grav Apple, or Gravity, or Triple Dive is used.
“The battle was pulled underwater!”
“The battle sank into the depths!”
This field will transform into Murkwater Surface if the move Sludge Wave is used 2 times, or the Z-Move Acid Downpour is used 1 time.
“The water was polluted!”
This field will transform into Icy Field if the moves Blizzard, Glaciate, or the Z-Move Subzero Slammer are used.
“The water froze over!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Elemental Seed boosts Special Defense and applies Aqua Ring to the user.
“[Pokémon] surrounded itself with a veil of water!”
The Dive Ball's catch rate buff is enabled.
